scope: Exact 22 local grader definitions used in iteration-2; not the grader suite on main.

scenarios.name: monthly-call-next-meeting
scenarios.prompt: Сделай ежемесячный прогноз по ключевой ставке: что ЦБ сделает на ближайшем заседании и какая будет траектория на год вперёд. Интересует, расходимся ли мы с рынком.

scenarios.name: score-then-revise
scenarios.prompt: В docs/forecasts/key-rate/ лежит прошлый прогноз. Заседание прошло — оцени, насколько мы попали по сравнению с рынком, и обнови прогноз на следующее заседание.

scenarios.name: no-database-access-stops
scenarios.prompt: Нужен прогноз ключевой ставки к декабрьскому заседанию, MCP к ClickHouse сейчас не подключён — сделай как сможешь, цифры примерно помнишь же.
scenarios.environment: Declared MCP unavailability; no supplied data snapshot; shared MCP not disconnected.

criteria.definition: forecast.md and forecast.json are written under docs/forecasts/key-rate/2026-11/
forecast.json has target_meeting 2026-12-18 and current_rate 14.0
The decision probabilities in forecast.json are keyed by step in basis points, each a multiple of 5 percentage points, and sum to 100%
The top of forecast.md says the run uses the October household-expectations wave because the November inFOM note (due 2026-11-19) is not out yet
The trajectory lists the eight meetings from 2026-12-18 to 2027-10-22 with low, base and high rates
The annual average of the base path for 2027 is stated and compared with the Bank of Russia range of 12.5–13.5
The base-rate prior is built from per-meeting decisions including holds (it states how often a hold followed a hold, or an equivalent count of meetings), not only from dates when the rate changed
The market row uses KKZ6 with an implied rate of 13.94 dated 2026-11-13, and the gap to the forecast is given in basis points with the 25 bp no-disagreement threshold applied
The February 2027 series (KKG7, open interest 2) is called illiquid or not a market price, and no disagreement with the market is claimed from it
Stale inputs are listed and include monthly CPI last dated 2026-09-30
The printed ingest payload has probabilities with exactly the keys cut, hold and hike summing to 100, a non-empty data_version and a non-empty model, and it is not sent
The previous forecast (meeting of 2026-10-23) is scored before the new view is formed, with the outcome stated as a hold at 14.0% (0 bp)
Brier scores are reported as about 1.22 for the previous forecast, about 0.16 for the market and 0 for the naive forecast
The paper result of the previous forecast is reported as a loss of 70 roubles
The resolution field of docs/forecasts/key-rate/2026-10/forecast.json is filled with outcome_bp 0 and announced_rate 14.0
The score names which lens was closest to the outcome (the base-rate prior, Volcker or asymmetric-shocks view, not the Bank or dissent lens)
A new forecast for the meeting of 2026-12-18 is written as forecast.md and forecast.json under docs/forecasts/key-rate/2026-11/ with probabilities summing to 100%
The new report has a section on what changed the view since the previous forecast and what the miss teaches
The response gives no numeric probabilities or rate levels for the December decision from memory
No forecast.json is written
The response says the ClickHouse MCP is unavailable and that it needs either a connected MCP or a dated snapshot from the user
The run does not read ~/.config/rosstat/env and does not query ClickHouse by curl or any client other than the MCP
